# Shai-Scanner Community Resources

Welcome to the heart of the shai-scanner community! 💜

This directory contains everything you need to engage, contribute, and get help.

## Resources

| Document | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| [Guidelines](GUIDELINES.md) | How to participate, our code of conduct, and communication norms |
| [Contributor Recognition](CONTRIBUTOR_RECOGNITION.md) | How we celebrate the amazing people who help build shai-scanner |
| [FAQ](FAQ.md) | Answers to the questions everyone asks |

## Ways to Get Involved

### 🐛 Report a Bug
Open an [issue](https://github.com/asx8678/shai-scanner/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) with reproduction steps.

### 💡 Suggest a Feature
Start a [discussion](https://github.com/asx8678/shai-scanner/discussions) or open an issue with the `enhancement` label.

### 🛠️ Contribute Code
Read the [Contributing Guide](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), then pick up an issue labeled `good first issue`.

### 📣 Spread the Word
Star the repo, write a blog post, tweet about it — every bit helps!

### 🎉 Show Off Your Setup
Use the Showcase discussion template to share how you're using shai-scanner in your project.

## Code of Conduct

We follow the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/). Be kind, be respectful, be excellent to each other.

See also: [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Communication Channels

- **GitHub Discussions** — Ask questions, share ideas, showcase projects
- **GitHub Issues** — Bug reports and feature requests
- **Twitter/X** — Follow [@shaiscanner](https://x.com/shaiscanner) for updates

## Discussion Templates

We provide templates to help you get started with discussions:

- **Q&A Template** — For questions about shai-scanner usage, configuration, or troubleshooting
- **Feature Request Template** — For suggesting new features or improvements
- **Showcase Template** — For sharing how you're using shai-scanner in your project
- **Contributor Nomination Template** — For nominating contributors for recognition

All templates include helpful prompts and validation checklists to ensure you provide all necessary information.
